steps: Chrome GUI plan/build/run executes protocol 11 through real Godot. Three bindings on two targets issue six real commands and two natural completions. The two bindings on A share one review group; B has a separate group. A retains target anchor 4 while the global cutoff is 6. A source button captured before switching to B cannot navigate after the switch.

Both existing command and completion rows open their exact target group and selected record. Natural-completion anchor controls select A command 4 and B command 6, retaining the separate global cutoff. Chinese, English and Japanese preserve the same focused picker, selected group and completion at 390px without horizontal overflow.

Frozen source actions open A first binding, A second binding, B binding, animation, each target’s selected clip and B completion subscriber at their exact UTF-16 source ranges. Builds, runs, target selection, anchor jumps, language changes and source navigation leave every author file byte-for-byte unchanged.
